title: Free-floating Subdivisions: Corporate Bodies
summary: List of topical (sec. D) and form (sec. E) subdivisions usable on a free-floating basis, within the limits of their usage notes, under names of individual corporate bodies in the name authority file (businesses, institutions, associations, religious organizations, political parties, government agencies, exhibitions, fairs, etc.). Not for conferences, jurisdictions (H 1140), or types of organizations. The list has no May Subd Geog column: geographic subdivision is allowed only where the note says "May subd geog." Pattern sheets H 1151/1155/1159/1186/1187 add subdivisions for specific categories. Full list in rules/lists/H1105.json.
validation_rules: The subdivisions on the sec. D (topical) and sec. E (form) lists may be used, within the limitations of the usage notes, as free-floating subdivisions under names of individual corporate bodies established in the name authority file: businesses and corporations, nonprofit institutions, voluntary associations, cultural institutions, religious organizations, political parties, fraternal groups, labor organizations, professional societies, clubs, international agencies, government agencies on all levels, and individual exhibitions, fairs, expositions, etc. (H 1105 sec. B)
Do not apply this list to names of individual conferences, congresses, or meetings; to names of jurisdictions (use H 1140); or to subject headings for types of organizations. (H 1105 sec. C)

Additional or varying subdivisions apply to bodies covered by pattern headings: H 1151 (educational institutions), H 1155 (legislative bodies), H 1159 (military services), H 1186 (religious and monastic orders), H 1187 (Christian denominations). (H 1105 sec. B)
Subdivisions representing classes of persons (e.g. `--Employees`, `--Officials and employees`, `--Presidents`, `--Chaplains`) may be further subdivided by H 1100 subdivisions. (H 1105 sec. B)

A subdivision from this list may be followed by a geographic subdivision only when its note says "May subd geog." (`--Collectibles`, `--Homes and haunts`, `--Information resources management`, `--Performances`, `--Political activity`, `--Press coverage`, `--Public relations`, `--Publishing`, `--Research`, `--Travel`, `--Vocational guidance`) or, for `--Officials and employees--Salaries, etc.`, only under names of countries, cities, etc. (H 1105 sec. D)

Explicitly not subdivided geographically: `--Accreditation` (under corporate bodies), `--Chaplains`, `--Corrupt practices`, `--Customer services`, `--Information technology`, `--Medals`, `--Museums`, `--Officials and employees--Accidents`, `--Sanitation`, `--Security measures`. (H 1105 sec. D)
Use `--Employees` under nongovernmental corporate bodies; use `--Officials and employees` under international, government, or quasi-governmental agencies. (H 1105 sec. D)

Use `--Appropriations and expenditures` under government agencies and institutions for their financial affairs; use `--Finance` under nongovernmental bodies and under government agencies only for management of non-appropriated funds. (H 1105 sec. D)

Use `--Administration` under individual libraries and institutions in health, social services, and education (and types of such institutions, types of education); under other corporate bodies (including government agencies, galleries, museums, parks) use `--Management`. (H 1105 sec. D)
`--Medals` is for corporate bodies other than military services; under military services use `--Medals, badges, decorations, etc.` (H 1105 sec. D)
Do not use `--Rules and practice` under individual educational institutions and military services; use `--Regulations` (cf. H 1151, H 1159). (H 1105 secs. D-E)

`--Party work`, `--Platforms`, and `--Purges` are used under names of individual political parties; `--Positions`, `--Procurement`, `--Public records` under individual government agencies; `--Privileges and immunities` under individual international agencies. (H 1105 sec. D)
Event subdivisions `--Explosion, [date]` and `--Fire, [date]` are free-floating (also under names of individual buildings, structures, etc.); format the date per H 1078. (H 1105 sec. D)
`--Claims vs. ...` is completed with the name of the jurisdiction against which the claim was brought, e.g. `--Claims vs. United States`. (H 1105 sec. D)
`--Anniversaries, etc.` is not used for works merely published on the occasion of an anniversary. (H 1105 sec. D)

Collection subdivisions (`--Art collections`, `--Library`, `--Herbarium`, etc.) apply only where the body is the owner/collector and no separate corporate heading exists (e.g. `--Art collections` not under art galleries or museums; `--Library` only if the collection is not a formally organized library). (H 1105 sec. D)
[LC practice] LC catalogers no longer use form subdivisions; assign LCGFT (e.g. `Textbooks`). Form subdivisions remain valid LCSH. (H 1105 sec. E)

sections.heading: A. Recent revisions
sections.text: 2026-01: Updated template. Corrected document metadata. Separated general and form subdivisions. Added instructions related to LCGFT implementation.

sections.heading: B. Types of headings covered
sections.text:
The subdivisions listed below may be used, within the limitations of the usage notes, as free-floating subdivisions under names of individual corporate bodies established as headings in the name authority file. The category includes businesses and corporations, nonprofit institutions, voluntary associations, cultural institutions, religious organizations, political parties, fraternal groups, labor organizations, professional societies, clubs, international agencies, government agencies on all levels, etc. The category also includes names of individual exhibitions, fairs, expositions, etc.

Additional or varying subdivisions may be used under names of individual corporate bodies that fall within categories covered by specific pattern headings. Consult the appropriate instruction sheet for corporate bodies covered by pattern headings:

- H 1151 for individual educational institutions
- H 1155 for individual legislative bodies
- H 1159 for individual military services
- H 1186 for individual religious and monastic orders
- H 1187 for individual Christian denominations

Some subdivisions on this list represent classes of person, for example, *--Employees* and *--Officials and employees*. See H 1100 for further subdivisions used under classes of persons.

sections.heading: C. Types of headings not covered
sections.text: This instruction sheet does not apply to names of individual conferences, congresses, or meetings. Names of jurisdictions are not included. For subdivisions used under names of jurisdictions, see H 1140. Subject headings for types of organizations are also excluded.
